Attend, but have her firm pay for the flights and hotel rather than the issuer
Accept, because the travel is modest relative to her annual compensation

explanation: Standard I(B) guidance says that when commercial transportation is available, the analyst or her firm should pay for travel and lodging on issuer site visits; issuer-arranged transport is acceptable only when no commercial option exists. distractorExplanations.a: Disclosure does not cure the conflict; the guidance is to avoid issuer-paid travel when commercial options exist.
distractorExplanations.b: Declining is unnecessary: site visits are legitimate due diligence when the analyst controls the costs.
distractorExplanations.d: Materiality relative to salary is not the test; issuer-paid travel can still compromise independence.
